brief_narrative:
[Client], a construction and building materials company, wants to develop a new business model centered on a digital marketplace to secure competitive advantage going forward. Their conditions are explicit: develop and scale it with minimal cannibalization on the current business; scale globally quickly by leveraging their existing assets; set it up so they keep strategic control without losing speed; and make sure learnings flow back into the parent organization. They have a view on which markets are strategically interesting to them, based on current position and innovation interest. [Client] has issued an RFP and we are responding.

The question they are asking us is how they can create a foothold in the emerging digital space that leverages existing assets while opening new revenue streams and future-proofing the business, without major cannibalization or short-term loss.
